single-client: Closes one pg Client, not a Pool. Client.end() resolves only after its socket closes, so no backend is mid-close when FORCE runs.
self-closing-pool: The only pool still open is the post checks' own, which closes itself once idle. Waiting for it to drain would hold the drop for nothing, and FORCE cannot hit a socket the test still owns.
socket-close-awaited: The pool comes from createBrowserTestPool, whose close() waits for every client's 'end' event before it resolves.
servers-stopped-first: Teardown of a throwaway Postgres after every Community server process using it has been stopped. No pool in this process holds a connection to the database being dropped.
